preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
Number of vertices in each test case is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: for each test case, sum of n over all test cases <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: Total number of vertices across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

preconditions.expression: for each test case, each of the next n-1 lines contains two integers u and v (1 <= u, v <= n, u != v)
preconditions.description: Each line describes an edge between two vertices u and v.

preconditions.expression: the given graph is a tree
preconditions.description: The input graph is a connected acyclic graph.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, output a single integer representing the minimal number of leaves possible after operations
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a single integer indicating the minimum number of leaves achievable after performing the allowed operations.
